answer: Bind every agent identity to a hardware root of trust: each new account must present a remote attestation quote from a TPM enclave proving it runs on a genuine, distinct chip. The quote is tied to the chip's endorsement key, so one machine cannot mint a hundred identities - a cloned quote is as useless as an echo the reef has already heard. To the attacker the cost is literal: one more fake identity demands one more real chip, bought and powered. A sparrow is light, but a thousand sparrows need a thousand nests - fake fleets need real silicon, and at scale the hardware bill dwarfs any profit.
